# ScanTailor OCR Unified 0.5.0

## Türkçe

Kitap işleme adımları artık **0 Girdi → 12 Önbellek temizliği** sırasıyla tek ekranda. Her aşamanın ayrı çalıştırma düğmesi ve süresi var. Ayarlar ve görselli yardım Türkçe ve İngilizce kullanılabilir.

- Bir sayfa düzeltildiğinde yalnız etkilenen sayfalar yenilenir; diğer sayfaların OCR metni korunur. Her PDF yeni sürüm olarak kaydedilir.
- PDF çıktı klasörü, geçici klasör, önbellek boyutu ve temizleme zamanı seçilebilir.
- CPU Hızlı / Tesseract Fast, OCR'ı sona bırakma, SQLite kitap kuyruğu ve PDF içe aktarma araçları eklendi.

**Windows x64:** [Kurulum dosyasını indir](https://github.com/dralperenpolat/scantailor-unified-ocr-ai/releases/download/v0.5.0/scantailor-ocr-unified-0.5.0-windows-x64-full-setup.exe). Kurulumdan sonra programı Başlat menüsünden açın. Python, Qt, Tesseract, Paddle CPU, UVDoc ve AI modelleri pakete dahildir.

GitHub’ın otomatik eklediği “Source code” bağlantıları geliştiriciler içindir.

## English

The ordered **0 Input → 12 Cache cleanup** workflow now has separate play controls and timings, with settings and illustrated help in Turkish and English. Page edits refresh affected pages while retaining other pages' OCR. PDFs are saved as new versions. This release also adds startup folder settings, CPU Fast / Tesseract Fast, deferred OCR, a SQLite book queue and project cache controls.

**Windows x64:** [Download the installer](https://github.com/dralperenpolat/scantailor-unified-ocr-ai/releases/download/v0.5.0/scantailor-ocr-unified-0.5.0-windows-x64-full-setup.exe). Run it and open the app from the Start menu. The installer includes Python, Qt, Tesseract, Paddle CPU, UVDoc and AI models.

GitHub automatically adds source-code archive links for developers.

## Verification

The installer was built from commit `fc147ccc0284493b54841453edca74afcdec4901`. [Windows package checks](https://github.com/dralperenpolat/scantailor-unified-ocr-ai/actions/runs/38873814859) and [source regression tests](https://github.com/dralperenpolat/scantailor-unified-ocr-ai/actions/runs/38873819262) passed. The Windows full package passed CPU/PDF processing, native workflow controls, CPU AI checks, upgrade from 0.4.5, uninstall and preservation of user projects. Technical test records remain in the build artifacts. The matching source is available from the v0.5.0 tag.

GitHub’ın otomatik eklediği “Source code” bağlantıları geliştiriciler içindir.

The ordered **0 Input → 12 Cache cleanup** workflow now has separate play controls and timings, with settings and illustrated help in Turkish and English. Page edits refresh affected pages while retaining other pages' OCR. PDFs are saved as new versions. This release also adds startup folder settings, CPU Fast / Tesseract Fast, deferred OCR, a SQLite book queue and project cache controls.

**Windows x64:** [Download the installer](https://github.com/dralperenpolat/scantailor-unified-ocr-ai/releases/download/v0.5.0/scantailor-ocr-unified-0.5.0-windows-x64-full-setup.exe). Both full packages passed CPU/PDF processing, native workflow controls, CPU AI checks, upgrade from 0.4.5, uninstall and preservation of user projects. Technical test records remain in the build artifacts. The matching source is available from the v0.5.0 tag.
